source_text: Eice ancillam et filium eius. Non heres cum filio liberae. Duo testamenta.
pass_a_gloss: Cast-out maidservant and son her. Not heir with son of-free-woman. Two covenants.
pass_b_english: [[Cast out the bondwoman and her son >> Bible:Genesis 21:10]]. He shall not be heir with the free woman’s son. [[Two covenants >> Bible:Galatians 4:24]].
